notes.title: Update - 1.0.4.0 - Major Optimization Improvements (and Merch!)
notes.notes:
Greetings Potions Masters,

You will note this is a larger patch than usual! This patch contains massive optimization overhauls and required restructuring of the project. These optimizations should greatly reduce load times, especially on lower end machines, and will provide memory performance improvements as well. 

We are also working on some free endgame content for you to enjoy, including a new temple to explore, the Temple of Spirit! Unfortunately, it is not ready to share just yet, but we’re sure you’ll enjoy the puzzles and strategic boss fight when it is released! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11598932/79844f30d4323ba1d30181362349927e0594c853.jpg

Finally, before we get into the patch note details, I wanted to let you know that the Helios plushie is now available along with various extra items from our Kickstarter backer rewards, including a gorgeous book, The Art of Potions: A Curious Tale, full of both lore and developer commentary. If you’d like to adopt your own Helios, explore the art and creative decisions behind Potions, or enjoy posters and postcards of Luna and Helios, then please check out: https://www.stumblingcat.com/merch


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11598932/5cc6988b5a2cc5a1ab6810043bdff2023c98d302.png

Now onto the changes/fixes:


 Load time optimization improvements
 Memory usage optimization improvements 
 Fixed multicraft bug that would occasionally eat ingredients upon increasing craft count
 Fixed bug causing Mac builds to crash on game exit 
 Prince Charming returns to the Inn at the end of the game with a better attitude (so he can be used to get his related achievement) 
 Fixed bugs preventing Horse and Mold Key interactions with mouse click (in the Swamp and Temple of Destruction)
 Added broom instruction tips to player’s first encounter with gaps after receiving broom
 Fixed various environment audio sounds that would erroneously persist through level transitions 
 Fixed bug that caused the Groostlang to move the stalactites in his room
 Fixed bug that allowed stalactite times to desync during menu and dialog pauses 
 Fixed saved dwarf run orientations so they won’t run backwards upon rescue 
 Updated Grootslang health bar to properly reflect fight mechanics 
 Added mold puzzleroom hint poem in the Temple of Destruction
 Buffed all of the Furious potions to do more damage 
 Recategorized Minor Protective Draught as an Earth potion 
 Recategorized Greater Sandstorm Potion as an Air Potion
 Fixed Card Gate interaction glow
 Corrected achievement grant for crafting first potion (because Granny was giving it to you a smidge too early)
 Moved the credits to the main load scene and removed from the main menu
 Added cooldowns for closing popup windows to prevent accidental closures
 Sphinx now animates properly for all of her dialog options 
 Fixed bug where Chimera would spawn on top of Luna when she exits from its lair 
 Fixed bug where card names wouldn't load properly when page turned from a blank card in their section in the Magical Card Book
 Fixed bug where a limited chase range wouldn’t break aggro and cause monsters to run away while still facing Luna
 Luna’s footsteps stop when the game is paused
 Fixed bug that could cause Luna to lose her mounted status between levels
 Fixed missing Darkness sounds in the Temple of Destruction 
 Fixed Snail animation bug
 Fixed various issues with Emily’s golem illusion scene in the Temple of Truth
 Jinn is now less likely to instantly fly back into his bottle on spawn
 Added gate close noises to buttons so it is more apparent how they are deactivating gates
 Added extinguish sound to turning lanterns off via the deluminator 
 Fixed missing dragon roar SFX in dragon dialog 
 Fixed bug where forge timer would increase while game was paused
 Fixed bug that would allow interruption of dialog by exiting Granny’s house 
 Fixed World Cauldron and World Equipment bug that would briefly teleport you to Granny’s house on exit back to the world
 Fixed minor layering issues in the Temple of Life
 Fixed rare bug that could prevent Luna from teleporting home when stunned
 And many, many more minor fixes! 


Thank you so much for all of your help identifying these issues and for your support of Potions: A Curious Tale. I am truly grateful to be able to share this world with you, and I hope to share the new content with you soon, too!

With Magic, 

Renee

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11598932/72bdbbe23099caed8560a580359957ecf9ab6952.jpg

notes.title: Update - 1.0.3.0 - Craft Autofill, Rebinding, and a Plushie Design!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Potions Masters!

I’ve just released a patch for Potions: A Curious Tale that includes a bunch of wonderful quality of life improvements, including:


 “Autofill” crafting ingredients from a recipe
 Controls rebinding*
 Graphics optimization options 
 Magical Card Book has a new view that shows 9 cards per overview page
 Updated art for Prince Charming and Calum MacDonald (the farmer)
 Granny provides helpful crafting tips when you craft unexpected outcomes
 Improved mana display on item views
 Improved lava area entrance visuals
 Increased font sizes for better visibility on the Steam Deck and small screens
 And more!


*Please note that rebinding mouse left click to other actions causes interaction issues, though you can unbind it. Use “Restore Defaults” in the Controls menu to restore left click interaction functionality. 

As well as minor bug fixes including:


 Miniquest NPCs no longer will give unsolvable quests 
 Fixed missing genie boss fight audio 
 Fixed bug where you could freeze your controls interacting with the genie
 Crafting book now displays proper number of owned potions
 Saved dwarves run fully away from Grootslang
 Fixed environment sound artifacts in Farm 2 and Fairy Forest 1


Some of these changes touch a significant number of systems, so please let me know if you run into any bugs or other issues. 

I also plan to enable Steam Cloud Saves once I get a greenlight from Valve that any old, possibly corrupt data has been removed from their Cloud Save servers. 

Finally, as I have been working on the design and manufacturing of the Potions: A Curious Tale Kickstarter physical rewards, I decided to look into creating an item that I have dreamed of– a Helios plushie! I would love for everyone to have their own sharp-tongued feline companion at their side. 

This design is by the extremely talented Julie Godwin, previously of Funko. If you would be interested please fill out this: Helios Plushie Interest Survey

Thank you again for your support, and have a magical week! 

With Magic,

Renee

notes.title: Patch - 1.0.1.0 - Lost Save Recovery
notes.notes:
Greetings Potions Masters,

The Situation

Due to unexpected issues around enabling Steam Auto-Cloud Save, some players may have had their main game save files overwritten by previous demo save information. (You can read more details about this issue here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/378690/view/7409056619623908850?l=english )

The Solution

This build adds a "Recover Save" button to the Load Game screen, which attempts to rebuild a player's saves by scraping player log files on their machine. Please only use this functionality if your main save is missing and you are on the machine that you were playing on previously. This should recover your game progress, quests, collected cards, recipes, and bestiary entries. As recovering items and potions were not possible, it also provides 5 potions from every recipe you've learned.

If you have NOT started a new game or made new progress since you last played your lost save: 

- Select "Load"
- Select "Recover Save"

If you HAVE started a new game or made new progress since your lost save:

If you would like to use the Recover Save function and have played the game since your save files disappeared, you will first need to clean your logs with the following steps. 

- If you are trying to recover an old save and have started a new game since playing that save.
- Going into your save and log file location (makes sure hidden files are visible): 
 Windows: C:\Users\[user]\AppData\LocalLow\Stumbling Cat\Potions_ A Curious Tale\
 Mac: ~/Library/Application Support/Stumbling Cat/Potions_ A Curious Tale
 Linux: ~/.config/unity3d/Stumbling Cat/Potions_ A Curious Tale
- Make a copy of this folder in a safe location on your computer in case you accidentally remove a log file you need. 
 You may also wish to do this even if you did not create a new game to further backup this process.
- Go into the Log folder.
- Remove the logs dated with your playtime of those "new" saves into a different file.
- Then use Recover Save. 

If you have started a new game and do not remove the new game’s logs as described above, it will start adding your newer game quests to your more advanced save, causing confusing quest log information. 

An Apology

From the bottom of my heart, I am so very sorry about this incident. I never would have imagined a situation like this would have occurred from enabling the Steam Auto-Cloud Saves. It absolutely wrenches my heart to think that enabling this function has damaged the beloved saves of so many players. I hope that this recovery function helps any of those who have been affected. If you have any additional issues, questions, or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to me at: renee@stumblingcat.com


Thank you so much for your understanding. 

Sincerely, 

Renee

notes.title: v0.9.9.6 Update - Now Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings, potions masters!

We're thrilled to bring you the latest patch update for "Potions: A Curious Tale," packed with enhancements aimed at refining your gameplay experience and immersing you deeper into the magical world we've crafted together. Let's dive into the cauldron of updates!

What's New in the Brew?

 Recipe & Item Books at Your Fingertips: Access your recipe book and item book directly from the action bar while exploring, making it easier than ever to concoct the perfect potion on the go.
 Equipment Backpacks: Change your equipped potions anywhere in the game world with the new equipment backpacks, available at every world cauldron. Perfect for those unexpected encounters!
 Enhanced Controller Handling: We've fine-tuned the controller support to ensure a smoother and more intuitive gameplay experience, letting you focus on the magic at hand.
 Quicker Potion Throwing: The animation and speed of potion throwing have been increased, making it easier to target those pesky moving enemies.
 Asset Improvements: New sound effects for many endgame creatures, and enjoy the final dialog art for our dwarven friends.
 UI Improvements: We've restored button rollover and select click sounds to add that satisfying feedback to your menu navigations, and controllers now properly interact with scrolling menus. 

Important Fixes:

 Passive Enemy Behavior: A pesky bug causing passive enemies to occasionally turn aggressive without reason has been squashed.
 Resolution Settings (Widescreen Fix): For our widescreen users, we've added resolution settings for windowed mode. For the best experience, please use a 16:9 resolution setting.

Your Adventure Awaits:
These updates are part of our ongoing commitment to make "Potions: A Curious Tale" as enjoyable and immersive as possible. We're always listening to your feedback and looking for ways to improve the game.

Your thoughts and suggestions are invaluable to us. Please continue to share your experiences, and let's brew this potion to perfection together!

Thank you for your continued support and for being a part of this magical journey. Here's to many more adventures in the enchanting world of "Potions: A Curious Tale"!

Enchanting Regards,

Renee

notes.title: v0.9.9.6 Update - Now Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Potions Masters!

We're thrilled to announce that the latest build of "Potions: A Curious Tale," version 0.9.9.6, is now available for both our beta players and those enjoying the demo! This update brews together a concoction of enhancements designed to enrich your gameplay experience and immerse you further into our magical world.

Quality of Life Improvements: We've listened to your feedback and added some much-requested features to make your adventure smoother and more intuitive. Enjoy the convenience of save file browsing and keep track of your potions' effects with new icons!

For Our Beta Players: Prepare to challenge your wits with an array of new puzzles, each designed to test your potion mastery in fun and engaging ways. And that's not all – we're excited to reveal that all 56 magical cards are now hidden throughout the game, waiting to be discovered. Collect them all to unlock mystical card gates and unveil the secrets they protect!


Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping this build, and we can't wait to hear what you think of the new features and content. As always, our potion lab is buzzing with ideas for future updates, and we're already stirring up the next batch of improvements and surprises.

None of this would be possible without your incredible support and enthusiasm. Whether you're a long-time player or just starting your potion-crafting journey, we're so grateful to have you with us.

Wan to learn more about the latest updates? Join us in our Discord for the full patch notes and more:  https://discord.gg/QS2SN55CC4

Happy potion brewing, and here's to many more adventures together!

With Magic,

Renee
